Chapter 1 was a monumental slog for me (patience issue due to roguelike exploration every second), but after that, I got more comfortable. Something interesting is the difficulty sometimes encountered, sometimes being negated by 5 free revives that freely replenish. (which is really neat imo bc skill issue). 
The topic of the story revolving around not forgetting people, or memories in general, is quite a random but welcome treat of a theme
It's like a reminder to not let my brain start failing, and to preserve mental notes I've made about my own friends and written things

items.title: [正面] One of the f2p friendly gacha, fairly relaxing wit...
items.summary:
One of the f2p friendly gacha, fairly relaxing with a good amount of challenging stages/boss fights, a good amount of content and resources! 

If you plan to spend some money I would reccommend it as most packages offer a good amount of currency for a low price. The charater designs are interesting with some that are obviously appealed to gooners, but thankfully it is only few/ 

The only con I have with his game is, while there are male characters it is very few. However, that seems to be changing in the future, Gtulu is going to release sometime this year and their last character was also male! 

So far my experience is a 8.5/10. It'd be cool if they added a boss rush, fix up their UI a little bit more and just add more male characters and it would be a 10 for me.
